attchmntText: Maan Aluminium Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Maan Aluminium Limited has published a newspaper advertisement pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The advertisement was published on 15th November 2026 in the Financial Express and Jansatta. This follows the outcome letter dated 14th November 2026 regarding the Board of Directors meeting. The meeting considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. The company filed this notice with the Bombay Stock Exchange and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The scrip codes are 532906 for BSE and MAANALU for NSE.

attchmntText: Maan Aluminium Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Maan Aluminium Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at a Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 27,948 lakhs, with a net profit of 89 lakhs. Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share stood at 0.15. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 51,134 lakhs, with a net profit of 399 lakhs. Basic and Diluted Earnings Per Share were 0.67. The company's paid-up equity share capital remains at 2,999 lakhs with a face value of Rs. 5 per share. The results were reviewed by the audit committee and approved by the Board.

attchmntText: Maan Aluminium Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Maan Aluminium Limited has announced an Earnings Conference Call for investors and analysts to discuss operational and financial performance for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The call is scheduled for Wednesday, 18th November 2026, at 04:00 PM IST. This follows the Board of Directors meeting held to announce the Q2 FY27 financial results. Management personnel including Chairman and Managing Director Ravinder Nath Jain, Executive Directors Priti Jain and Ashish Jain, and Chief Financial Officer Umesh Chandra Pant will participate. The audio and video recording along with the transcript will be made available later. Details are available on the company website at www.maanaluminium.com.
